scope.description: An optional optical direction for a user-requested single object and a user-requested secondary silhouette. Keep the physical object intact and near-realistic, while shaping its one attached cast shadow so it also suggests the specified second reading. The double reading lives in the shadow only; no second physical subject is added. This adapts a documented optical device without copying a particular double-image painting.
limitations: Activate only when the user explicitly requests an ordinary object and a second silhouette suggested by its cast shadow.
Preserve the physical object's identity, count, material, silhouette, and recognizable details.
Keep the second reading inside the shadow only; do not render it as a separate animal, person, object, or reflection.
Maintain one coherent light direction and an attached shadow with plausible contact and perspective.
Keep the shadow's secondary shape suggestive rather than so literal that the object appears physically transformed.
Do not add melting clocks, deserts, ants, statues, or other familiar Dalí motifs unless the user requests them.

rules.applies_when: The user requests a cast shadow that suggests one specific second form.
rules.instruction: Place the second reading wholly within the object's cast shadow; keep its cues in contour, width, and negative space rather than adding another physical form.
rules.observable: At first glance the image contains one ordinary object; on closer inspection the attached shadow also suggests the user-specified second silhouette.
rules.reject_when: A second bird, person, prop, or face appears outside the shadow, or the shadow fails to remain connected to the object.
rules.avoid: separate doubles, mirror reflections, hidden faces unrelated to the user request

rules.applies_when: The shadow's outline is deliberately transformed.
rules.instruction: Keep the object itself in its expected proportions, material, and silhouette; place the optical anomaly in the shadow contour rather than melting or fusing the object.
rules.observable: The object is immediately identifiable and materially plausible, while the anomaly is localized to the projected shape.
rules.reject_when: The object deforms to resemble the second form, loses a defining feature, or merges with the shadow.
rules.avoid: melting objects, extra limbs or parts, morphing the object into the shadow's subject

rules.applies_when: The scene uses a single dominant light source.
rules.instruction: Keep the shadow's contact point, length, and direction consistent with one readable light source; use only the far contour or a limited internal notch to suggest the second silhouette.
rules.observable: The shadow still reads as a projection attached to the object, despite its double interpretation.
rules.reject_when: Several contradictory shadows appear or the second silhouette floats free of the object.
rules.avoid: multiple light directions, detached shadow figures, decorative shadow clutter

joint_checks.instruction: Preserve one recognizable object under one coherent light source, and keep the user-requested second silhouette perceptible only in its attached cast shadow.
joint_checks.observable: The image remains a lucid still life until the viewer notices the shadow's second reading; no separate secondary object is present.
